# JujedieFR - Planet Generator on itch.io

> > JujedieFR's itch.io page featuring Planet Generator, a GPU-accelerated worldbuilding tool built with Godot 4 for procedural planet generation and climate simulation.

Planet Generator is a specialized worldbuilding tool that uses procedural generation to create detailed planets with realistic biomes, climate models, and resource distribution. The tool underwent a major v2.0.0 revamp utilizing Godot 4, Vulkan, and GPU compute shaders for enhanced performance.
